item.title: Kyle MacLachlan Does An Ask Me Anything And Answers All Kinds Of Questions
item.description: David Lynch's "Twin Peaks" may have ended years ago, but fans are still hungry for cherry pie and inside information about the series. Luckily, star Kyle MacLachlan is an internet sensation, and he was kind enough to do a virtual Q&A for fans of the iconic show. Here's a peek behind the curtain and into the mind of Agent Dale Cooper!

item.title: Man Tries To Control His Girlfriend’s Clothes And It Backfires, Internet Can’t Hide Excitement
item.description: He hates that his teacher girlfriend dresses like Ms. Frizzle for work. But his main gripe is that she sees no problem wearing her unusual outfits in public too. In a bid to get her to dress more “normal,” he told his GF that his mother was embarrassed to been seen out with her. To say he got schooled is an understatement...

item.title: “AITA For Asking My Sister To Move After She Refuses To Babysit My Son?”
item.description: The arrangement felt tense from the start. A single parent opened her home to her younger sister, hoping a simple exchange of childcare and light chores would ease the financial strain. But within weeks, the agreement began to unravel as expectations clashed and resentment grew on both sides. What began as a temporary lifeline quickly turned into a conflict over responsibility, fairness, and family support and the fallout forced both sisters to confront what help really means.

item.title: 51 Widely Believed “Facts” That Aren’t True At All
item.description: You can’t trust everything you hear. But people sometimes talk with such confidence that it’s hard not to believe them. Not that they’re necessarily trying to mislead anyone—although, in certain cases, they might be—but most of us simply don’t have the time to double-check every claim we come across. And that’s exactly why some myths keep circulating for years even after they’re debunked.

item.title: 79 Wild Tumblr Gems The Internet Refused To Forget (New Pics)
item.description: Tumblr often veers off the beaten path. Here, rabbit holes reign supreme and strange tangents take unexpected twists and turns of their own. It's easy to get lost in the collective chaos. So here's a list of Tumblr posts that have nothing in common, except that they're all a bunch of wild thoughts that once popped into someone's head, and ended up online.

item.title: 93 Times People Designed Signs That Made No Sense And Made Everyone Lose Their Minds (New Pics)
item.description: If signs like "Road work ahead" ever confused you, this might be just the list for you. Sometimes, designers experiment with logos, placards, and signs, and this time we're looking at the times when they weren't successful in their experiments. From the subreddit that shames signs that you can't read from left to right, here is a compilation of the most confusing and nonsensical sign designs.

item.title: 48 Wild Posts From The Online Group Delusions Of Adequacy That Are Pure Internet Energy (New Pics)
item.description: It starts with a post that feels oddly confident, slightly chaotic, and impossible to ignore. In this corner of the internet, people share thoughts that range from strangely insightful to completely off the rails, often landing somewhere in between. The result is a collection of screenshots that capture the humor of everyday overconfidence online. Scroll through for a mix of bold takes, accidental comedy, and moments that make the internet endlessly entertaining.

item.title: 77 Involuntary Celibates Who Ended Up As The Saddest Clowns On The Internet (New Pics)
item.description: Incels are people who often gather online to blame, objectify, and insult women and girls and spiral into long rants about how they’ve been dealt a bad genetic hand. They have their own vocabulary, and sometimes their rants can turn into actual violence and spill into the real world. See some of the screenshots here to find out just how extreme and bitter incels can get.

item.title: Former Mayor Misty Roberts’ Mugshot Raises Eyebrows As Religious Symbols Steal The Spotlight
item.description: Former Louisiana mayor Misty Roberts faces backlash after her dressed-up mugshot surfaced following her conviction for an intimate encounter with her son’s underage friend.

item.title: “Did You Also Do This As A Kid?”: 26 Things That Everyone Thought Were Unique To Them
item.description: Kids make up all sorts of weird things. Sometimes they’re trying to imitate the adults in their circles, while other times, it’s just their imagination and sense of discovery taking over. It always leads to hilarious and somewhat relatable results. But what if all those quirky things that you thought were unique to you weren’t so rare after all?
